name: Astro
shortDescription: Web framework delivering zero-JS by default with Island Architecture for content-rich sites.
description: A modern web framework focused on delivering zero-JS by default to the browser, Astro excels at content-rich sites with outstanding performance and supports Island Architecture so you can hydrate only what you need. Its seamless integration with React, Vue, Svelte, and others plus first-class MDX/content tooling make it a great fit for fast marketing sites, blogs, and documentation.
useCases: Blogs, docs, and marketing sites with best-in-class performance
Content-heavy pages with minimal client JS
